```{r}
#| label: try-then-check
#| echo: false

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph try_then_check {
  graph [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    bgcolor = 'transparent'
    compound = true
    nodesep = 0.5
    ranksep = 0.8
  ]

  node [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 12
    style = 'filled,rounded'
    fontcolor = 'white'
    penwidth = 0
    shape = box
    margin = '0.25,0.12'
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 10
    arrowsize = 0.8
  ]

  subgraph cluster_productive {
    label = 'Produktiver Weg'
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 14
    fontcolor = '#0072B2'
    style = 'rounded,filled'
    fillcolor = '#dce8f5'
    color = '#0072B2'
    penwidth = 1.5

    try [label = '1. Versuch\\nEigenen Ansatz\\ngenerieren' fillcolor = '#0072B2']
    compare [label = '2. Vergleich\\nMit KI-Output\\nabgleichen' fillcolor = '#56B4E9']
    reflect [label = '3. Reflexion\\nSchema\\naktualisieren' fillcolor = '#E69F00' fontcolor = '#222222']

    try -> compare [label = '  Prediction Error  ' color = '#666666']
    compare -> reflect [label = '  Analyse  ' color = '#666666']
    reflect -> try [label = '  Nächster Zyklus  ' color = '#666666' style = dashed]
  }

  subgraph cluster_unproductive {
    label = 'Unproduktiver Weg'
    fontname = 'Helvetica'
    fontsize = 14
    fontcolor = '#D55E00'
    style = 'rounded,filled'
    fillcolor = '#fde8d8'
    color = '#D55E00'
    penwidth = 1.5

    direct [label = 'KI-Output\\ndirekt nutzen' fillcolor = '#D55E00']
    passive [label = 'Passives\\nÜbernehmen' fillcolor = '#D55E00']
    nolearn [label = 'Kein\\nLerneffekt' fillcolor = '#D55E00']

    direct -> passive [color = '#999999' style = dashed]
    passive -> nolearn [color = '#999999' style = dashed label = '  Keine Reflexion\\n  möglich  ']
  }
}
")
```
